chapter: Army, return to El Paso and Mardi Gras parades
title: Takings, Charlie Weaver and exhausted Mardi Gras days
summary: Nelson says the Zulus made 45 dollars, Allen mentions comedian Charlie Weaver playing cornet, and they trade stories of tiring parade day.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: They made 45, Nelson told me that night. I don't know. That's what Nelson told me. I didn't know. I asked him for it. Who did he? Nelson did about right now. Oh yeah? 45. Can you beat that? They walked just one week. They walked one week. Can you beat that?

Pete was as happy as he could be. Yeah, they walked one week. And Charlie Weaver played Cornette with him, you know, the comedian. You didn't know, I didn't know that. He's on the Today Show or something. Is he? Yeah.
Not that, what is he? Charlie Weaver, the comedian?
Can he play Cornette? He had it.
Sure enough. Old baggity-pants, please. Yeah, Charlie Weaver. I've seen him on many programs.
Jack Parr actually used to play. Yeah, he used to be often on Jack Parr. But he was playing on that thing. No, I've never seen him play nothing. No, but he was playing alone.
He was just after trumpet. Can you beat that?
He and, alas, Jack was, because they were playing a duet and I couldn't hear it too good. I don't remember too well. I was a... He was high.
Well, I was tired. You was riding with Shorty? Yeah, he had Shorty.
I was, well I got up at 5.30, the same as you I guess. And, by that time that was 12.30, I was dead tired. Then I walked, you know. Oh, Jesus God. I caught four clubs.

What, you had your equipment? No. No, no, I was just walking. You were just walking. No, you were just walking. And you caught four clubs. Second clubs. You had to jump to catch them four clubs. Yeah.
Well, I did catch a little bus ride down then. That was moving, you know. And Ron, in case of the bus. You know, you're not going to catch him on the bus. No.
You probably saw me, but you wouldn't recognize him. No, you wouldn't know that.
No. I had my costume. He was masked. Oh, uh-huh. The Mardi Gras. Yeah. The roles of the Mardi Gras.
